segments.text: C. xxv. This Chapter contains the laſt public Diſcourſe, which our LORD uttered before He was offered up. He had before frequently declared what would be the Portion of all the Workers of Iniquity. But what will become of thoſe who do no Harm? Honeſt, inoffenſive, good Sort of People? We have here a clear and full Anſwer to this important Queſtion.
